entries.en: Ms Addison sorted the photographs by date before putting them in the album.
entries.zh: 艾迪生女士先按日期把照片整理好，再把它们放进相册。

entries.meaningZh: 女子（美，非正式；此处非特定性别表达身份义）
entries.en: In the old detective story, the stranger introduces his companion as 'a resourceful femme'.
entries.zh: 在那篇老侦探小说里，那个陌生人把他的同伴介绍为“一个足智多谋的女子”。

entries.en: She discussed the case with her classmates at Wharton before writing her analysis.
entries.zh: 她先在沃顿商学院与同学们讨论了这个案例，然后才撰写分析。

entries.meaningZh: 呸（表示轻蔑或不信的感叹用法）
entries.en: 'Pooh!' she said. 'That excuse won't fool anyone.'
entries.zh: “呸！”她说，“那个借口骗不了任何人。”

entries.en: Johann folded the map along its creases and slipped it into his coat pocket.
entries.zh: 约翰沿着折痕把地图折好，塞进了自己的外套口袋。

entries.en: Their train reached Sofia just as the station lights came on.
entries.zh: 他们乘坐的火车到达索非亚时，车站的灯刚好亮了起来。

entries.en: Regan checked the address twice before sealing the envelope.
entries.zh: 里根把地址核对了两遍，才封好信封。

entries.en: We spent a quiet afternoon in Toulouse while the rest of the group went shopping.
entries.zh: 其他组员去购物时，我们在图卢兹度过了一个安静的下午。

entries.meaningZh: 哈里奇（此处指英国城镇）
entries.en: The delivery van stopped in Harwich so the driver could check the next address.
entries.zh: 送货车在哈里奇停了下来，让司机核对下一个地址。

entries.en: Angie held the ladder steady while her neighbour replaced the bulb.
entries.zh: 邻居更换灯泡时，安琪扶稳了梯子。

entries.en: Mr Roth pencilled a question beside the last paragraph of the draft.
entries.zh: 罗斯先生用铅笔在草稿的最后一段旁边写了一个问题。

entries.en: The doubleheader climbed the steep grade with a long line of freight wagons.
entries.zh: 那列双车头火车拖着一长串货车车厢爬上陡坡。

entries.en: Waite paused at the doorway to let the children carry their model outside.
entries.zh: 韦特在门口停下脚步，让孩子们把他们的模型搬到外面去。

entries.meaningZh: 凯恩（姓氏, 美国北极探险家）
entries.en: Ms Kane counted the spare chairs before the visitors arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到来之前，凯恩女士数了数备用椅子。

entries.meaningZh: 斯基普顿（此处指英国城镇）
entries.en: The coach left Skipton before dawn, with most of the passengers still asleep.
entries.zh: 长途客车天亮前就离开了斯基普顿，大多数乘客还在睡觉。

entries.en: The tutor asked us to explain Bentham's argument before criticising it.
entries.zh: 导师让我们先解释边沁的论点，再提出批评。

entries.en: Georg set a bowl beneath the leak and moved the books away from the wall.
entries.zh: 格奥尔格在漏水处下面放了一个碗，又把书从墙边移开。

entries.en: Dr Farrell sketched the proposed footbridge on the back of an envelope.
entries.zh: 法雷尔博士在一个信封背面画出了拟建人行桥的草图。

entries.en: Ms McKenna left a note explaining which seedlings needed extra water.
entries.zh: 麦肯纳女士留下了一张便条，说明哪些幼苗需要多浇些水。

entries.meaningZh: 戴姆勒（英国的高级汽车名）
entries.en: A polished Daimler stood beside the entrance to the vintage car show.
entries.zh: 一辆擦得锃亮的戴姆勒汽车停在老爷车展入口旁。

entries.meaningZh: 卢[瑟福](放射物质的蜕变单位)
entries.en: The old laboratory report recorded the sample's activity in rutherford units.
entries.zh: 那份旧实验室报告用卢瑟福单位记录了样品的放射性活度。

entries.en: Mr Kettering waited until the rehearsal ended before speaking to the conductor.
entries.zh: 凯特灵先生一直等到排练结束后，才去和指挥说话。

entries.en: Myra tucked the receipt into her notebook so she would not lose it.
entries.zh: 迈拉把收据夹进自己的笔记本，免得弄丢。

entries.en: The students compared their interpretations of Kant after the seminar.
entries.zh: 研讨课结束后，学生们比较了各自对康德的解读。

entries.en: Mrs Hess wrapped the repaired cup in tissue before putting it back in the box.
entries.zh: 赫斯太太先用薄纸包好修复的杯子，再把它放回盒子里。

entries.meaningZh: 迪德科特（此处指英国城镇）
entries.en: They met in Didcot to exchange the boxes before continuing in opposite directions.
entries.zh: 他们在迪德科特碰面交换了那些箱子，然后继续朝相反方向赶路。

entries.en: The choir stayed in Ripon for one night before travelling north.
entries.zh: 合唱团在里彭住了一晚，然后继续向北行进。

entries.meaningZh: 黑格尔（德国古典唯心主义哲学家）
entries.en: The reading group devoted a second meeting to Hegel because the first discussion had raised so many questions.
entries.zh: 由于第一次讨论提出了许多问题，读书小组又安排了一次会议来讨论黑格尔。

entries.en: The curator unfolded an old map of Bengal to show where the cloth had been made.
entries.zh: 馆员展开一张孟加拉的旧地图，说明那块布是在哪里制作的。

entries.en: Rain began to fall as they stepped off the bus in Hanoi.
entries.zh: 他们在河内刚下公共汽车，雨就下了起来。

entries.en: Ms Redmond marked the damaged parcel and set it aside for inspection.
entries.zh: 雷德蒙女士在受损的包裹上做了标记，把它放在一旁等待检查。
